description: Multi-agent / team attribution rollup. Returns how many currently-valid top-level memories each agent (agent_id, set at store time) wrote — { by_agent, by_author, total } — distinct from author (the human/source). Memories stored without an agent_id are bucketed under "unattributed". Optional scope/namespace filters scope the rollup.

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

name: memory_attribution
